description: Engine temperature must not exceed 110°C under normal operating conditions.
Engine RPM must not exceed 6500 under normal operating conditions.
Battery voltage must remain within 11.5V–14.8V during operation.
The system must detect and report every out-of-range sensor reading in a log file, with no false negatives.
The system must not raise a fault for a log file containing entirely valid readings.
The system must continue operating without crashing if a log file is missing or unreadable.
Every fault detected must be traceable to a specific row and timestamp in the source log.
